On 31 May 1964, [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the title after a 4-16 to 6-6 aggregate win over [[New York GAA|New York]] in the final. It was their 11th league title overall and their first since [[1960-61 National Hurling League|1960-61]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} In spite of finishing at the bottom of their respective groups, neither [[Clare GAA|Clare]] or [[Carlow GAA|Carlow]] were relegated.
